mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_waitlist (schedule_id, member_id, status) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{memberId}, 'WAITING')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reservation_waitlist WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation_waitlist WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT w.*, p.title as performanceTitle, sc.show_date as showDate, sc.show_time as showTime FROM reservation_waitlist w JOIN schedule sc ON w.schedule_id = sc.schedule_id JOIN performance p ON sc.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM reservation_waitlist WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation_waitlist SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reservation_waitlist SET status = 'NOTIFIED', notified_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
